rules.title: Run once in CI mode
rules.text: Run tests once with vitest run or CI=true. Plain vitest starts watch mode in an interactive terminal.

rules.title: Run a subset
rules.text: Pass a file path or a -t name pattern to run a subset while developing.

rules.title: test.each for tables
rules.text: Use test.each with a title format to cover many cases without copy-pasted tests.

rules.title: Fake timers
rules.text: Control time with vi.useFakeTimers and vi.advanceTimersByTime, and restore real timers after the test.

rules.title: Keep isolation on
rules.text: Keep test isolation enabled. Disable it only for suites with no shared state, through a separate project.

rules.title: Restore mocks
rules.text: Restore mocks between tests with restoreMocks in config or vi.restoreAllMocks so mocks never leak.

rules.title: Inline snapshots
rules.text: Prefer inline snapshots for small outputs and review them like code.

rules.title: Type-level tests
rules.text: Test exported types with expectTypeOf in *.test-d.ts files.

rules.title: Browser mode
rules.text: Use browser mode with a real browser provider instead of jsdom when layout or event behavior matters.

rules.title: Colocate tests
rules.text: Place *.test.ts files next to the source they cover.

rules.title: No .only
rules.text: Remove .only before committing. The lint setup may not catch it.
